meta.title: 公司里事情推不动？把「我的事」变成「我们的事」
meta.title_en: Why Nothing Gets Done at Work

scenes.context: 讲者指出推不动的事都不挂KPI，没有利益绑定大家凭什么配合你。
sentences: 推不下去的事，大概率都跟KPI没有关系。
Tasks that stall almost never connect to anyone's KPIs.
KPI：key performance indicator
如果跟KPI挂钩起来，不用你推，大家都会自己卷自己。
Once it's tied to their KPIs, you won't need to push — everyone competes on their own.
自己卷自己：compete on your own
大家心里面会想：办你的事，就没有时间办自己的事情。
Deep down they think: if I do your task, I won't have time for my own.
亏本买卖：a losing deal
paraphrase: 推不动=没挂上对方利益
Things stall when they're not tied to anyone's interests.
Make them care because it's their problem too.
scenes.speak: Tasks that stall almost never connect to anyone's KPIs. Once it's tied to their KPIs, you won't need to push — everyone competes on their own. Deep down they think: if I do your task, I won't have time for my own.

scenes.title_en: Three ways to move things forward
scenes.context: 讲者给出三个解法：利益挂钩、经营人情、拆解任务。
sentences: 没有人有义务配合你，除非把我的事变成我们的事。
No one is obligated to help you — unless you turn my problem into our problem.
变成我们的事：make it a shared problem
要么挂钩他的利益，要么给他造成风险，请你二选一。
Either tie it to his interests or create a risk for him — pick one.
挂钩利益：tie to interests
把任务拆解到实习生都能做的傻瓜程度，然后再交给他们。
Break the task down until even an intern can do it, then hand it over.
拆解任务：break down the task
paraphrase: 推动力=利益绑定，不是道理
Momentum comes from aligned interests, not logic.
Lower the startup cost for the other side.
scenes.speak: No one is obligated to help you — unless you turn my problem into our problem. Either tie it to his interests or create a risk for him — pick one. Break the task down until even an intern can do it, then hand it over.

scenes.title_en: If you must pick one: tie it to interests
scenes.context: 讲者强调三点做好就搞定大部分问题，并给出自己的选择。
sentences: 请先把这三点做好：第一利益挂钩，第二欠你人情，第三拆解任务。
Master these three first: align interests, bank favors, and break tasks down.
欠你人情：owe you a favor
这三点都做到，二八法则中的大部分就搞定了。
Nail all three and you've solved most of the 80/20 problems.
二八法则：the 80/20 rule
如果资源有限只能选一条，我选利益挂钩。
If you can only pick one with limited resources, I'd pick aligning interests.
资源有限：limited resources
paraphrase: Most problems come down to a few levers.
scenes.speak: Master these three first: align interests, bank favors, and break tasks down. Nail all three and you've solved most of the 80/20 problems. If you can only pick one with limited resources, I'd pick aligning interests.

practice: 表达「把事变成我们的事」
Let's make this a shared problem.
Tie it to what everyone gains.
Break it down so anyone can start.
pitfalls: ✕ 直译腔：Hang your interests on it.
✓ 地道说法：Tie it to their interests.
挂钩→tie to，比 hang on 更地道。
✕ 直译腔：Let others owe you a human relationship.
✓ 地道说法：Get people to owe you a favor.
✓ 地道说法：Break the task down.
✓ 地道说法：Everyone competes on their own.
shifts: 靠设计对方的利益与风险
footer_notes: ASR 校正：「心一面」校正为「心里面」、「脸书」校正为「脸熟」、「茶瓜程度」校正为「傻瓜程度」、「不能低乎」相关口误已按语境修正；「酱香拿铁」为品牌梗保留。
